# Cursor Agent 2026.10.01 catalogue identity

Secret-free identity evidence for `cursor-agent.catalogue` from its qualified
`2026.09.18-9a7762b` ceiling to official ACP registry stable
`2026.10.01-14929f9`. The three published hops are `2026.09.26-dd393fe`,
`2026.09.28-64d2043`, and `2026.10.01-14929f9`. Registry commits, exact
Darwin ARM64 and Linux x64 archive URLs and hashes, embedded Node identities,
selected command chunk identities, and the complete package file manifests
are frozen in `identity.json` and `dist-inventory.json`.

The complete inventory excludes only macOS AppleDouble `._` resource-fork
entries. It records exact path, byte size and SHA-256 for each file in each of
the four compared release trees on both platforms. Every adjacent-hop added,
removed, changed and byte-identical path set is included, with a digest for
each set. Selected catalogue entry, handler and model-service files are
classified by role for each hop; remaining packaged build and provider
features are not transferred to the catalogue claim.

Static inspection shows the `models` registration and output mapping persist:
model id from `displayModelId` or `modelId`, and display name from
`displayName` or `displayNameShort`. The adapter extracts default status only
from its exact `(current, default)` suffix and exposes no separate current
field. The configured account path retains the same endpoint/auth inputs and
available-model request. New `Tip` wording is ignored by the adapter. The
`team` command, local-provider branch, model invocation/parameter behavior,
ACP, and headless remain outside this qualification.

The exact installed host version observed with an isolated `--version` probe
was `2026.09.18-9a7762b`. Downloaded archives were read and hashed, never
executed. No catalogue request, provider prompt, credential use, installation,
or host update occurred. npm package metadata remains a separate identity
axis.
